title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E2 — Joan Rivers, George Gobel
Flip does the shell game; Joan does stand-up and plays a cabdriver; Freddie Johnson buys jewelry from Gobel & Rivers.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E9 — Unappreciated Interest
Dorian pulls an illegal scam involving Frank’s credit card and makes matters worse by lying about it, behavior that could have dramatic consequences.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E10 — Thanksgiving
With Dee sick in bed with a bad cold, Moesha offers to prepare the Thanksgiving feast but finds herself engaged in a fierce cooking competition with Hakeem’s mother.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E11 — To Sleep, Perchance To Dream
Moesha starts having recurring romantic dreams about Hakeem, giving her second thoughts about their friendship and about sharing a room with him and Niecy on an upcoming ski trip.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E12 — He Doth Protest Too Much
Moesha discovers that some of her college classes are more difficult than she thought; she has a hard time in Chemistry and reluctantly agrees to let Niecy tutor her.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E13 — Let’s Talk About Sex
Moesha crashes in Niecy’s dorm room after a late-night Pendulum party and is horrified to discover that Nicey has also let a male sleep in the room.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E14 — Secrets and Lies
The arrival of Frank’s Aunt Hattie brings a shocking revelation about Frank that turns the rest of the family – especially Dorian and Moesha – against him.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E11 — Two Men And A Baby
Eddie enlists Malcolm to help babysit for his infant cousin.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E12 — The Way We Weren't
An argument leads to Malcolm and Eddie recalling their years together.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E13 — It Almost Happened One Night
An old rival's visit causes Simone to pretend she and Malcolm are husband and wife.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E14 — Whose Room Is It Anyway
An argument over whose room is largest lands Malcolm in the hospital.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E15 — Tough Love
Fired from her job and dumped by her girlfriend, Malcolm's sister arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E16 — A Decent Proposal
Nicolette enlists Malcolm and Eddie to convince her boyfriend to propose.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E14 — Piano Movers
A great deal on a grand piano finds Lamont and Fred lodged in the apartment of a wealthy eccentric.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E1 — The Light Housekeeper
When Fred Sanford receives a slight injury in a car mishap, Lamont finds himself waiting on his father hand and foot. Fred rejects the idea of having Aunt Ethel help him around the house and settles for Lamont's zany plan to hire a housekeeper.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E2 — Blood Is Thicker Than Junk
Lamont seeks employment elsewhere, forcing Fred to find a new partner for the junkyard. The situation becomes intolerable for Fred when he realizes his new partner is long on brawn, but short on brain.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E3 — By The Numbers
Fred gets that old feeling -- not love... the numbers!! He's sure he's dreamed up a winner, but Lamont refuses to let him place a bet. But Fred may not be the only loser.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E19 — The Hold Out
George gets caught between his morals and his money when his efforts to increase his take on a business deal turn him into an unlikely neighborhood hero.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E20 — The Ones You Love
The first casualty from George and Louise's vicious verbal battle could be the interviewer interested in their 'perfect marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E21 — Every Night Fever
An evening out at the disco turns into 'every night fever' when George stretches a good thing a bit too far. Louise's frustration grows when she realizes that she is to blame.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E22 — Three Faces Of Florence
Florence's efforts to make herself more 'interesting' backfire when her new suitor turns out to be a psychiatrist -- and 'interesting' Florence is one of the worst cases he's seen. George and Louise are worried over Florence's condition.
